# .deb + .rpm for the Linux release bundle (CPack). Driven by
# tool/ci/package_artifacts.sh --target linux; modelled on
# toxee/tool/ci/linux-installer.
#
# Layout: the Flutter bundle under /opt/morsecq (it must stay together: the
# runner finds lib/ and data/ next to itself), a /usr/bin/morsecq wrapper, the
# desktop entry and the hicolor icon theme generated by tool/gen_app_icons.dart.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(morsecq_linux_installer LANGUAGES NONE)

foreach(_var MORSECQ_INSTALLER_SOURCE_DIR MORSECQ_RELEASE_VERSION
             MORSECQ_PACKAGE_ARCH MORSECQ_DEB_ARCH MORSECQ_RPM_ARCH)
  if(NOT DEFINED ${_var} OR "${${_var}}" STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${_var} is required")
  endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${MORSECQ_INSTALLER_SOURCE_DIR}/morsecq")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "No morsecq runner in ${MORSECQ_INSTALLER_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

set(_app_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../apps/morsecq")

set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME "morsecq")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR "agentx-icu")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "agentx-icu <https://github.com/agentx-icu/morsecq>")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMARY "Morse code trainer and serverless Morse chat over Tox")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION
  "Learn Morse code with the Koch method and key it to friends and groups over the Tox peer-to-peer network. No server, no account.")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL "https://github.com/agentx-icu/morsecq")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION "${MORSECQ_RELEASE_VERSION}")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_FILE_NAME "morsecq-${MORSECQ_RELEASE_VERSION}-linux-${MORSECQ_PACKAGE_ARCH}")
set(CPACK_GENERATOR "DEB;RPM")
set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "/")
set(CPACK_STRIP_FILES OFF)

set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE "${MORSECQ_DEB_ARCH}")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_MAINTAINER "agentx-icu")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION "hamradio")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_COMPRESSION_TYPE "xz")
# Versioned Depends from the ELF files themselves (dpkg-shlibdeps): libc6 /
# libstdc++6 minimums follow the build host, so the package refuses to install
# where the binaries could not run. The libraries the bundle carries itself
# are private (resolved from opt/morsecq/lib, never turned into Depends).
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS_PRIVATE_DIRS "opt/morsecq/lib")
# Plus what is only loaded at run time (dlopen), so shlibdeps cannot see it:
# the tray indicator, secure storage and ALSA for the sidetone.
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_DEPENDS
  "libayatana-appindicator3-1, libsecret-1-0, libasound2t64 | libasound2")

set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE "${MORSECQ_RPM_ARCH}")
set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_LICENSE "GPL-3.0-only")
set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_GROUP "Applications/Communications")
set(CPACK_RPM_COMPRESSION_TYPE "xz")
set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_URL "https://github.com/agentx-icu/morsecq")
# rpmbuild derives Requires from the ELF files; the libraries bundled under
# /opt/morsecq are provided by the package itself (autoprov), so only system
# libraries end up as real requirements. Directories rpm already owns must
# not be claimed again.
set(CPACK_RPM_EXCLUDE_FROM_AUTO_FILELIST_ADDITION
  /opt /usr/share/applications /usr/share/icons /usr/share/icons/hicolor)

configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/morsecq-wrapper.in"
               "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/morsecq-wrapper" @ONLY)

install(DIRECTORY "${MORSECQ_INSTALLER_SOURCE_DIR}/"
        DESTINATION "opt/morsecq" USE_SOURCE_PERMISSIONS)
install(PROGRAMS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/morsecq-wrapper"
        DESTINATION "usr/bin" RENAME "morsecq")
install(FILES "${_app_dir}/linux/icu.agentx.morsecq.desktop"
        DESTINATION "usr/share/applications")
install(DIRECTORY "${_app_dir}/linux/icons/hicolor"
        DESTINATION "usr/share/icons")

include(CPack)
